claim_boundary: Benchmark, predicted, calculated, optimized and simulated evidence is separated; no realized field savings, certified aircraft safety, universal equipment transfer, or prospective production performance is claimed.

operations_research.objective: expected modeled lifecycle cost + risk_aversion * CVaR_alpha
operations_research.primary_solver: Gurobi when licensed runtime is available

real_operational_data.model_target: 24-hour failure horizon derived from published company failure windows; no fabricated row-level RUL

release_boundary: Pre-public V1 release candidate with benchmark, generic external-data, real historical operations, and CMMS/ERP reference exchange paths; live site connectors and prospective field validation remain external deployment work
signature_product: Reliability Observatory + Data Gateway + Reliability Shock Lab + Real Operations Command

stress_simulation.method: seeded Monte Carlo with common random numbers
